doctor.name: The Fabrico Team
bio: With over 15 years of experience in fabric care, our team has helped thousands of clients keep their clothes looking brand new.
We treat every garment with the utmost care and respect.

expertise.title: Expertise You Can Trust
expertise.note: No unnecessary treatments. No confusing jargon. Just honest care.

testimonials.text: I came in with severe pigmentation and dull skin. The personalised facial plan at Wenni completely transformed my skin in just two months. The team is so gentle and professional!
testimonials.name: Riya Sharma

testimonials.text: Did the Advanced Cosmetology course here. The trainers are incredibly patient and the practical sessions on live models made me job-ready. Landed a job at a top salon within a month!
testimonials.name: Priya Mehta

testimonials.text: My skin has never looked better. The acne treatment plan was completely personalised and painless. They explained everything clearly and never pushed unnecessary products.
testimonials.name: Anil Kumar

testimonials.text: Laser hair reduction done here — results are amazing and the sessions were surprisingly comfortable. The studio is spotless and booking on WhatsApp was super easy.
testimonials.name: Sneha Patel

testimonials.text: The anti-aging glow ritual gave me back my confidence. Professional, hygienic, and so relaxing — I actually look forward to my sessions every month!
testimonials.name: Meena Joshi

testimonials.text: Enrolled my daughter in the Basic Beauty Therapy course. The syllabus is well-structured and the hands-on training is fantastic. Highly recommend Wenni Academy to aspiring beauticians!
testimonials.name: Vikram Singh
